title: Power Apps: row summaries in model-driven apps reach GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing incorrectly reports that the environment control has no documented automation: the Power Platform API exposes the shared AI insight cards setting and an update operation. The roadmap and licensing claims are supported, but this control gap must be corrected before publication.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary > Row summaries > environment > Edit setting reaches the environment control.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings. Under Power Apps, locate Row summaries in the Summary section. Select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document an automation call setting the row summaries environment control.
claims.quote: API Version: 2024-10-01. EnvironmentManagementSetting: | powerApps\_EnableFormInsights | boolean | |
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api and its rendered gap with kind 'power-platform-api', call 'PATCH /environmentmanagement/environments/{environmentId}/settings?api-version=2024-10-01', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/environmentmanagement/environment-management-settings/update-environment-management-settings'. Add the note 'The request body sets powerApps_EnableFormInsights, the shared AI insight cards setting.' Cite the same-version property reference at https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/environmentmanagement/environment-management-settings/list-environment-management-settings and the identification of EnableFormInsights as AI insight cards at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/modern-controls/modern-control-data-grid#ai-row-summaries. The existing row-summary source already confirms AI insight cards and Row summaries are the same control.

claims.claim: Power Apps (maker) > Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary reaches the prompt and summary visibility configuration screen.
claims.quote: Under Customizations, select Row summary. In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle in the upper-right corner to show or hide the summary.
claims.fix: For the visibility control, extend controls[1].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary'. Retain the same docs URL; the Prompt box is on this configuration screen.
